Body Noesis® Academy

Training & certification for health professionals

If you are a health professional, Body Noesis® opens a new field: you attract people of every age and fitness level who want to get stronger, recover and change how their body looks — through an immediate change in posture, from the very first sessions.

The method

What is Body Noesis®

A system of exercise, rehabilitation, strengthening and psychosomatic wellbeing for everyone. Every person is unique: each exercise is adapted to the needs of the trainee, so the best possible result comes in the right way — with small, consciously controlled movement, safely.

0%alignment
  1. Principle 1

    Small, consciously controlled movement

    Each exercise works one muscle group at a time: with a controlled, targeted minimal movement on the body’s axes, it takes the muscles to the maximum of contraction or stretch.

  2. Principle 2

    The pelvis is our centre

    A building starts from its foundations. Special pelvic-floor exercises — beyond Kegel — give the trunk a stable base and control of movement when we walk, sit and move through the day.

  3. Principle 3

    Deep muscles, elastic fascia

    The method activates the whole muscular system in depth, including the deep stabilising muscles, improves neuromuscular coordination and the elasticity of the fascia — for strength, flexibility and correct posture.

  4. Principle 4

    No machines, no impact

    No dangerous loads, no bouncing, no impact — the body is stabilised in a safe, comfortable position that protects the spine, the neck and the joints. Our gym is our own body.

  5. Principle 5

    A new movement pattern

    Reprogramming through the brain and motor patterns is the way to change: with many repetitions — sometimes up to 100 — the contractions are composed like a melody, and correct posture becomes how you move.

The right exercise takes no strain — it takes the right way.
Κατερίνα Καμπουγέρη

Body Noesis® grew out of the evolution of several methods — chiefly targeted muscular micro-contractions — with elements of Lotte Berk, Callanetics, 3D & Evolution, Pilates and Yoga, completed after many years of study and research.

Katerina Kampougeri — creator of Body Noesis®

The creator

Katerina Kampougeri

Katerina Kampougeri holds a degree from the Department of Physical Education & Sport Science in Athens, specialising in Sports for All with distinction. She is the first Physical Education teacher in Greece to hold a diploma in the alternative exercise method she has taught since 2007.

Early in her career she worked in higher education as head of Sport and as representative of TEI Kalamata on the Ministry of Education’s committee for university sport, with national student championships. She has also worked in primary education and in Sports for All programmes.

She opened her own gym first in Kalamata and then in Athens, teaching every exercise programme — and she keeps teaching, with love, everyone who needs a different approach and guidance to reach their goals.

She specialised in spinal rehabilitation through special rehabilitation and strengthening exercises, studied an orthosomatic method in Zurich and holds a Certificate from the International Organization Physio Pilates. To address spinal dysfunctions she invented the Body Noesis® products and holds their patents with the Industrial Property Organisation.

Her trainees range from 12 to over 70 years old. Some have trained continuously for years — the more they practise the programme, the better they feel. She firmly believes, as they do, that Body Noesis® should become known everywhere.

What is Body Noesis®?

A system of exercise using targeted, controlled micro-movements of contraction or stretch, which safely improves strength, flexibility and posture. It needs no machines and involves no impact or bouncing.

Who can train and get certified?

Fitness instructors, physiotherapists, dancers, yoga and pilates teachers and health professionals in general. After the training a certificate is issued so that they can teach the Body Noesis® method.

How long is the professional training?

50 hours: 40 hours of training, live or online, and 10 hours of practice. Dates are announced or arranged with you.

Can it be done online?

Yes. Sessions and training run online on all popular platforms (Zoom, Google Meet, Viber, WhatsApp, Messenger) or live at your space or at our studios. In every case we first arrange the format, time and place together.

In which language is the training?

In Greek and in English, as well as in Spanish with simultaneous interpretation by Olga Lazara.

Who teaches?

Physical Education teacher Katerina Kampougeri, creator of the method, and Sylvia Lampe, President of CTASA in South Africa.

Who are the sessions for?

Every age from 12 to over 70, every gender and fitness level — even people who have never exercised or who live with musculoskeletal problems. Personal and mini-group sessions last one hour.

How do I order products from the eshop?

Add the products to the basket, fill in your delivery details and press “Send order”. The order reaches Katerina by e-mail and she contacts you to confirm it and the shipping cost.

How do I pay?

By bank transfer or cash on delivery. There is no card payment on the website — nothing is charged online.

Does Body Noesis® replace a doctor or physiotherapy?

No. Body Noesis® is an exercise method. With pain or a condition, diagnosis and treatment belong to your doctor; the exercises are adapted to what they have advised.
